title: 79% of company execs say employees work around their AI governance policies
summary: Your company has AI governance policies firmly in place. But is your staff using them? 4 in 5 executives say their employees are bypassing AI guidelines.
body_markdown: When AI is running mission-critical workflows, checking in quarterly isn't a control strategy.[Zapier](https://zapier.com/) acts as the managed layer between your AI agents and the apps they connect to. Every connection is OAuth-authenticated, and nothing runs outside of what your policies allow.
